title: Resilient Manufacturing Site
subtitle: OT historian + quality + maintenance → production resilience and cost per good unit

valueIntent.objective: Increase safe throughput and reduce cost per good unit
valueIntent.baseline: Illustrative 8 stops per shift; no validated cost attribution
valueIntent.benefitHypothesis: Unquantified pending cycle-time, scrap, margin and maintenance baseline
valueIntent.riskBoundary: Worker safety, OT segmentation, change control
valueIntent.autonomy: L1 recommendation / L2 ticket with approval

agents.name: Signal Steward
agents.mandate: Normalise source events, provenance, freshness and completeness

agents.name: Context & Graph
agents.mandate: Resolve assets, zones, owners, policy context and source conflicts

agents.name: Value Reasoner
agents.mandate: Evaluate materiality, counterfactuals, benefit ownership and confidence

agents.name: Intervention Planner
agents.mandate: Form choices with expected impact, dependencies and failure modes

agents.name: Policy & Risk Gate
agents.mandate: Enforce role permissions, OT safety, privacy, human approval

agents.name: Action Broker
agents.mandate: Issue authorised tickets and controlled commands; handle receipts and rollback

agents.name: Outcome Auditor
agents.mandate: Compare before/after, control for confounders, sign benefits and improve graph

valueStreams: Make money · Save money · Mitigate risk
partnerRole: OT integrator, reliability MSP, machine OEM
ciscoRole: Industrial networking, OT visibility/security, observability integrations

workflow.name: Observe
workflow.description: New source events arrive and are quality checked.
workflow.detail: Micro-stops, lower good-unit throughput and unresolved condition reports share a possible equipment dependency.

workflow.name: Contextualise
workflow.description: Join physical, operational and business context.
workflow.detail: Micro-stops, lower good-unit throughput and unresolved condition reports share a possible equipment dependency.

workflow.name: Hypothesise
workflow.detail: A targeted maintenance check may reduce recurring downtime without introducing unsafe OT changes.

workflow.name: Plan
workflow.description: Compare interventions, cost, confidence and risk.
workflow.detail: Schedule a controlled mechanical inspection and coordinate production-window access.

workflow.name: Guard
workflow.description: Apply the delegated authority and safety boundaries.
workflow.detail: Safety-critical industrial controls stay under OT/EHS authority. Human approval and site lockout procedures required.

workflow.name: Approve
workflow.description: The accountable human accepts or rejects the proposed action.

workflow.name: Act
workflow.description: Create authorised workflow actions with audit and rollback.
workflow.detail: Create a SIMULATED CMMS inspection work order; no PLC/SCADA commands.

workflow.name: Verify
workflow.description: Check pre/post data and counterfactual validity.
workflow.detail: Compare failure frequency and good-unit throughput across matched shifts after maintenance; control for product mix.

workflow.name: Learn
workflow.description: Publish verified evidence, or record unresolved gaps.
workflow.detail: Publish root-cause evidence and extend only if reliability gain is sustained and independently verified.

outcome.baseline: Illustrative 8 stops per shift; no validated cost attribution
outcome.benefitHypothesis: Unquantified pending cycle-time, scrap, margin and maintenance baseline
outcome.verification: Compare failure frequency and good-unit throughput across matched shifts after maintenance; control for product mix.

controls.riskNotes: Worker safety, OT segmentation, change control

provenance.sources: Illustrative operational values; not live Cisco/BMS data
